Metadata.description: {name} helps churches prepare weekly worship presentations from reusable liturgy templates.

Home.title: Prepare Sunday worship slides in minutes
Home.lead: Build each week's presentation from a reusable liturgy template instead of starting from a blank file.

templates.title: Liturgy templates
templates.body: Set the order of worship once and reuse it every week.

library.title: Songs and scripture
library.body: Pick a hymn or a passage and its slides are filled in for you.

present.title: Present and export
present.body: Run the slideshow full screen or download it as a PDF.

About.title: About {name}
About.lead: {name} is a management platform for churches. It starts with one job: preparing the slides for weekly worship.
About.why: Most churches rebuild the same presentation every week by copying last Sunday's file. {name} keeps the order of worship as a template, so the weekly work is only what changes: the songs, the readings and the sermon theme.

Contact.title: Contact
Contact.lead: Questions, feedback, or a request to delete your data: send an email and you will get a reply.

Login.title: Sign in
Login.lead: The admin panel is open to registered church and platform administrators.
Login.legal: By signing in you agree to the Terms of Service and the Privacy Policy.
